text: MEWA Textil-Service SE & Co. Management OHG (Wiesbaden) names its general partners in its imprint: MEWA Textil-Service SE and the Gabriele Gebauer MEWA Stiftung (a foundation), both in Wiesbaden. Die Deutsche Wirtschaft's register of family businesses names the Gebauer family as the owner.
short: MEWA is owned by the Gebauer family.

source.name: Mewa: Impressum
source.quote: Persönlich haftende Gesellschafterin: Gabriele Gebauer MEWA Stiftung, Wiesbaden
